questions.stem: In a Venn diagram, $15$ students play football, $12$ play tennis, and $5$ play both. How many play football only?
Using the same data ($15$ football, $12$ tennis, $5$ both) and $30$ students in total, how many play neither sport?
questions.explanation: Students playing at least one sport $= 10 + 5 + 7 = 22$ (football only + both + tennis only). Neither $= 30 - 22 = 8$.
